items.title: Zillow cuts 500+ jobs in its largest layoff of 2026
items.note: Second round this year, about 7% of staff, even as Q2 revenue rose 18% in a flat housing market

items.title: Omilia raises $67M Series B for its agentic CX platform
items.note: Expedition Growth Capital leads; ARR up 10x since Series A to over $60M serving Capital One, Discover, RBC

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.6-Cyber, a gated offense-grade security model
items.note: 95% completion on advanced cybersecurity tasks vs 1.5% for base model, access restricted to vetted defenders via Daybreak Red

items.title: Sapiom raises $35M Series A to run AI agents in production
items.note: Dragonfly-led round with Anthropic participating; already handling 270M+ transactions and 100K agent runs a day

items.title: Existing-home sales fall to a three-month low as rates hit a one-year high
items.note: NAR reports a 1.7% July drop to a 4.06M annualized rate while the median price sets a 37th straight monthly record

items.title: UWM raises $2.05B after a $451.9M Q2 loss and suspends its dividend
items.note: A $603M derivatives loss tied to its Two Harbors MSR bid nearly halved equity and tripled leverage at the largest US mortgage lender

items.title: Onyx Security raises $113M Series B at a $640M valuation
items.note: Bessemer-led round for AI agent governance comes just four months after a $40M stealth exit, backed by Cyberstarts

items.title: Xsight Labs raises $300M at a $2.8B valuation for AI networking chips
items.note: Fidelity-led round for the Tel Aviv DPU maker whose silicon just completed testing in SpaceX's new satellites
